response.overview: A painfully serious woman prepares to inherit the mantle of the Pitchfork Killer, a legendary serial killer whose bloody family tradition resurfaces every ten years. Determined to honour the legacy and secure her own place in the history books, she invites a documentary crew to chronicle her training, leaving no detail to chance. But with a notorious family reputation to live up to and no actual kills to her name, becoming a legend might prove harder than she anticipated.
response.title: Pitchfork Killer
